digest.component_or_area: LLM review operations (CLI, library, MCP tool)
propositions: Single-pass `rebar review` CLI verb and its library/MCP surfaces must be retired because `review-plan` gate supersedes it from above and deterministic checks supersede it from below

`rebar review` must become a loud deprecation shim that forwards to `review-plan`, preserves read-only semantics by forwarding `--no-sign`, and rejects unsupported arguments (`--graph`, positional `reviewer_id`) with exit code 2 rather than silently accepting them

Internal call sites in `review_workflows.py` (line 86) and `eval_solver.py` (line 310) must call private `_review_ticket_impl` directly to avoid double-signalling deprecation warnings, while the MCP tool emits only the `mcp` deprecation signal
Three deprecation rows must be registered in `_deprecations.REGISTRY` as `_scheduled` entries (not permanent) for the CLI, library, and MCP surfaces, all with `remove_in=v1.0.0`

`review-plan` fast-fails with exit 2 on non-claimable tickets (closed/idea/blocked/prerequisite-blocked) without running the LLM, diverging from the old verb's behavior; this divergence must be documented in help text and tested

Output schema key `review` must be repointed from `REVIEW_RESULT` to `PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT`, with `REVIEW_RESULT` re-wired under synthetic `review_ticket` key to cover the surviving library/MCP surface
